    dimH (intersection exponent ratio) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (dimensionUpperBound ratio)

noncomputable def dimensionUpperBound (ratio : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  max (2 * Real.log 2 / Real.log (1 / ratio) - 1) 0

theorem first_lower {exponent : ℝ} (hexponent : 1 < exponent) :

theorem linear_regularity :

      dimH exceptional ≤ 1 ∧

theorem root_fibres {exponent : ℝ} (data : RootFibreData exponent) : RootFibreConclusion data

structure RootFibreData (exponent : ℝ) where
  exponent_gt_one : 1 < exponent
  lower : ℝ
  upper : ℝ
  lower_gt_quarter : 1 / 4 < lower
  upper_lt_half : upper < 1 / 2
  ordered : lower ≤ upper
  leftWord : ℕ → Bool
  rightWord : ℕ → Bool
  leftLength : ℕ
  rightLength : ℕ
  root : (ℕ → Bool × Bool) → ℝ
  root_in_band : ∀ digits, root digits ∈ Set.Icc lower upper
  left_positive : ∀ (digits : ℕ → Bool × Bool) (ratio : ℝ), ratio ∈ Set.Icc lower upper →
    0 < cylinderCoordinate leftWord leftLength (fun index => (digits index).1) ratio
  right_positive : ∀ (digits : ℕ → Bool × Bool) (ratio : ℝ), ratio ∈ Set.Icc lower upper →
    0 < cylinderCoordinate rightWord rightLength (fun index => (digits index).2) ratio
  unique_root : ∀ digits ratio, ratio ∈ Set.Icc lower upper →
    (cylinderResidual exponent leftWord rightWord leftLength rightLength digits ratio = 0 ↔
      ratio = root digits)
  derivative_lower_bound : ℝ
  derivative_lower_bound_positive : 0 < derivative_lower_bound
  transverse : ∀ digits, derivative_lower_bound ≤
    |deriv (cylinderResidual exponent leftWord rightWord leftLength rightLength digits) (root digits)|

def RootFibreConclusion {exponent : ℝ} (data : RootFibreData exponent) : Prop :=
  rootLaw data.root ≪ volume ∧
    ∀ᵐ ratio ∂rootLaw data.root,
      dimH (intersection exponent ratio) = ENNReal.ofReal (expectedDimension ratio)

theorem denominator (numerator denominator : ℕ)

theorem fourier_density_eq_measureFourier {density : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hmeasurable : AEStronglyMeasurable density volume)

def HasSobolevDensity (probability : Measure ℝ) (regularity : ℝ) : Prop :=

      ‖addressFourier ratio frequency‖ ^ 4)

    probability = volume.withDensity (fun value => ENNReal.ofReal (density value)) ∧
    (∫⁻ frequency : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal
      (Real.rpow (1 + |frequency| ^ 2) regularity *
        ‖𝓕 (fun value => (density value : ℂ)) frequency‖ ^ 2)) < ⊤

theorem canonicalSobolevEnergy_eq_convolution_energy (ratio regularity : ℝ) :

theorem canonicalSobolevEnergy_eq_densityFourier
